purpose: Blind H1 census of article-level innovation and publication-time potential-impact indicators, formulas, validation evidence, and source dispositions from English full text.

scope.eligible_sources: Finally included English paper-level indicator definition, application, validation, prediction, or review-discovery records.
scope.allowed_evidence: The supplied English title/abstract, lawfully acquired local English full text, and source-linked prior title/abstract indicator hints.
scope.forbidden_inputs: H2 decisions, model performance, selected dimensions, final feature counts, Qwen/Ollama, local model output, and external LLM APIs.

source_dispositions.extracted: At least one indicator mention is extracted from sufficient English evidence.
source_dispositions.no_indicator: The complete available English source contains no in-scope article-level indicator or predictor.
source_dispositions.candidate_fulltext_missing: A title/abstract names a candidate, but sufficient English full text is unavailable to approve formula or T0 details.
source_dispositions.excluded_after_fulltext: Full text shows that the source or candidate is outside the paper-level/T0 scope.

extraction_requirements: Extract every distinct named indicator and retain raw name, canonical English name, Chinese label, aliases through repeated mentions, source identity, and independent research-group evidence.
Record an exact English evidence span and exact page, table, equation, appendix, or section location.
Record formula, units, parameters, direction, missing-data rule, required input data, and maximum information time.
Record positive, mixed, null, and negative validation evidence; do not retain only favorable findings.
A review may discover a name but cannot authorize a formula or primary/foundational evidence.
english_fulltext_verified and formula_reproducible may be true only when the local file hash and exact location are supplied.
Publication-time opportunity and context variables remain separately labelled and are never relabelled substantive innovation.
Future citation, attention, diffusion, disruption, acceptance, and model-output variables are outcome_only and cannot become T0 features.
Do not infer data availability, nonconstancy, stability, or construct validity merely from a name; state the evidence basis.
